target.name: Federated Premier Intermediate Municipal Income Fund

listed_quote.quote: Federated Premier Municipal Income Fund (NYSE: FMN) and Federated Premier Intermediate Municipal Income Fund (NYSE: FPT) have declared their monthly dividends.

announcement.quote: This press release mentions a reorganization, which, if approved by shareholders, would be conducted pursuant to an agreement and plan of reorganization that will be included in a registration statement, to be filed by FMN (Registration Statement).

deals.notes: The RW of 2017-10-05 withdrew the 2017-08-11 N-14 only because it used the wrong EDGAR form type; the registrant states it 'will re-file the Registration Statement using Edgar Submission Form Type N-14 8C' (re-filed 2017-10-06), so it is not a withdrawal of the merger. Joint annual meeting was set for 2017-11-14. The later excerpts (425s of 2017-10-30 and 2017-11-09, compact) show no outcome language, and the 2018-07-17 DEF 14A excerpt concerns only trustee elections for FMN; no excerpt states how the reorganization ended.

problems: Outcome not stated in the excerpts.
